purpose: Runtime knowledge source for support investigation tools (trace, fidelity-check, overbooking, ARI). Tools resolve channel/PMS modules here instead of hardcoding per-connector logic. Update = drop/edit a module, no tool redeploy.
update_protocol: One module per channel (channels.<CODE>) and per PMS (pms.<CODE>).
Every fact carries source_url + verified_at. Never fill from memory alone; null = unverified.
confidence: verified (seen in logs/docs this date), documented (wiki page, not log-verified), assumed (needs check).
On any live-case mismatch vs a module, fix the module AND bump its verified_at; bump schema_version only on structural change.
When a module is missing, tools run discovery mode and emit a stub skeleton to complete.

Tools append {ts, case, mode, ref, apps_confirmed_live, source} into module.history on every run (including zero-hit discovery runs via kb_write). The KB is the single source of truth for what has been tried.
kb-test anchor probes require example_anchors.trace_token + event_date per module; keep both populated.

canonical_model.description: Normalized reservation fields every tool maps endpoint docs into before diffing.

fields.reservation.id.pms: PMS-side locator (e.g. DIR-OTA1-...-1 in pms-hub, PMSA_XML confirmationID)
fields.pms.config.rate_without_tax: PMS delivery config flag: send before-tax amount (Yes|No)
fields.hotel.code.pms: Hotel code sent to the PMS (e.g. OXI000001, HOTEL01)
fields.correlation.message_uuid: PMS-bound message UUID / PMSA_XML Label id

OTA1.name: Channel One (New)

behavior_rules.rule: ChannelCollect rate plans are sent with NET rates; HotelCollect with GROSS rates
ChannelCollect NET observed = tax-INCLUSIVE, commission-exclusive (includesCommission=false); VCC remit equals AmountAfterTax

log_apps._note: fill with k8s app names on next log pull (candidate: nw-* / channelrelay components)

OTA1.resolution: needs-discovery: no log apps in KB; tool will try cm-ota1 convention then stop

behavior_rules.rule: cm-ota2/booking-gateway is keyed by the CM hotel UUID; property-api is keyed by the OTA hotel id
Always scan the bare confirmation code as a second pattern; for pms-hub scans the bare code is MANDATORY
PMSA_XML is PULL by PMS: completion = GET /pmsBookings/:id/revisions/:rev/status; status events Pending -> Delivered|Error

PMSA_REST.name: PMSA PMSA_REST
PMSA_REST.event_model: status events Pending -> Delivered|Error per flowToken

CLOUDPMS.name: CloudPMS
CLOUDPMS.connection: internal bridge (pms-cm-bridge); bookings drop into Front Desk via state-sync-api

query_templates.delivery_trace: for each app in module.delivery_apps: s3 grep '{ref}' OR '{cm_uuid}' OR '{trace_token}' in prod/{app} for date range; classify Pending/Delivered/Error
query_templates.fidelity_fetch: fetch channel-source doc (module.channels log_apps.reservation_inbound, by echo/trace token) AND pms-bound doc (module.pms delivery_apps, by message uuid/label); normalize both to canonical_model; emit per-field PRESERVED|TRANSFORMED|DROPPED|ADDED
query_templates.tax_semantics: if pms.config.rate_without_tax=Yes and pms_doc.rate.amount == channel_doc.rate.amount_after_tax and channel_doc.rate.amount_before_tax present -> verdict CONFIG_IGNORED
query_templates.ari_inbound_trace: no-token search: per day+hour loop, s3search query hub-xbridge ari-feed '<d>-<h>' "s.messageType='<rates|restrictions|availability>' AND s.hotelCode='<pms hotel code>' AND s.invTypeCode='<room>' AND s.ratePlanCode='<rate>'" | fgrep '<stay-date>'
query_templates.actor_attribution: s3search query cm avail-api-<ra|rb> '<d>-*' "s.propertyUuid='<uuid>' AND s.message like 'SET'" -> read client/originSystem
query_templates.bridge_ari_push: s3search query pms-cm-bridge avail-sync '<d>-<h>' "s.propkey='<propkey>' AND s.roomRateRef=<id>" | jq '.time,.flowToken,.msg'

tool_lessons.lesson: Never hand-pick component lists for trace sweeps: a system-wide '*' component scan found the booking that a curated other_apps list missed.
Low-selectivity follow keys (pmsType, hubPmsPropertyUuid, roomCode, ratePlanCode) sweep co-tenant traffic: f_* files from these kinds are context-only, excluded from gate evidence.
UPPERCASE RULE: CM booking IDs are stored UPPERCASE in every component; prefix presence varies by component.

PMS_BRIDGE_SYNC_DISABLED.meaning: bridgeEnabled or pmsAvailSyncOn not true - FD/calendar sync was disabled
PMS_BRIDGE_SYNC_DISABLED.fix_path: check bridge sync toggles + state-sync-api errors by propkey, then trigger flush and recheck

ERR_CONVERSION_UNMAPPED_ROOM_RATE.where: pms-hub/booking-api + pms-hub/pms-booking-events (conversion gate, before any PMS-specific connector)
ERR_CONVERSION_UNMAPPED_ROOM_RATE.meaning: Reservation created in CM but room/rate not mapped Channel Manager -> PMS; delivery never attempted
ERR_CONVERSION_UNMAPPED_ROOM_RATE.fix_path: map room/rate, then resend by hubBookingUuid/bookingRev

ERR_PMS_BUSINESS_ERRORS.meaning: PMS rejected the reservation with business errors (e.g. INACTIVE_HOTEL / rate plan not found in PMS)
ERR_PMS_BUSINESS_ERRORS.fix_path: Read the business-errors body for the exact reason and fix mapping on PMS side

ARI_NO_ROOM_RATE_SYNC.meaning: No Room Rate with sync enabled was found in DB
ARI_NO_ROOM_RATE_SYNC.fix_path: Verify sync toggles -> Sync Hotel with CM -> Flush -> recheck logs by propkey

ARI_XENGINE_DATA_LOSS.meaning: Per-channel ARI updates dropped between xengine and hub-xbridge
ARI_XENGINE_DATA_LOSS.fix_path: Count 'process' events per side for the same hotelCode+date window; workaround = PMS flush/resend

XENGINE_INVALID_CREDENTIALS.meaning: PMS push received but rejected on credentials
XENGINE_INVALID_CREDENTIALS.fix_path: s3search query xengine soap-gw <day>-* 's.hotelCode LIKE <code>' and read the error returned to the PMS

ERR_INTERNAL_PROCESSING_FAILED.meaning: Downstream HTTP call during PMS delivery failed (e.g. 413 payload too large, 404 property not found)
ERR_INTERNAL_PROCESSING_FAILED.fix_path: confirm hop+size via flowToken; check property-record sync
